finding.headline: Invoice INV-552310 has no Etail id

statement.text: Every invoice and credit memo carries the Shopify order id (the Etail id).

fix.action: Enter the Shopify order id in the Etail Order Id field of invoice INV-552310.

verify.passesWhen: Invoice INV-552310 carries an Etail id.

fix.darpanChanges: Nothing. Darpan reads NetSuite and the OMS; it never writes to them.

access.note: This API has no mutations. Fix the record in its own system; Darpan closes the finding at its next scheduled check.
